# hevo_pipeline_objects (Resource)

The Source objects a Pipeline replicates, as a desired set: with `select = "listed"` exactly the enabled objects in `objects` are replicated; with `select = "all"` every object is, except those disabled in `objects`. Objects selected or deselected outside Terraform show as drift. Removing this resource leaves the selection as it is.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Replicate exactly these three tables; anything else selected in the Hevo UI shows as drift.
resource "hevo_pipeline_objects" "postgres" {
  pipeline_id = hevo_pipeline.postgres.id
  select      = "listed"

  objects = {
    "public.orders"   = {}
    "public.payments" = { load_mode = "APPEND" }
    "public.users"    = { excluded_fields = ["ssn", "date_of_birth"] }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `pipeline_id` (String) The Pipeline, such as `hevo_pipeline.x.id`.
- `select` (String) `listed` replicates only the objects enabled in `objects`; `all` replicates every object except those disabled in `objects`.

### Optional

- `objects` (Attributes Map) Objects keyed by name, as the Pipeline lists them (for example `public.orders`). A child object follows its parent; name only the parent. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--objects))
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The Pipeline's id.

<a id="nestedatt--objects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `objects`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the object is replicated. Defaults to true.
- `excluded_fields` (Set of String) Fields of this object not to replicate.
- `load_mode` (String) This object's load mode, instead of the Pipeline's: `MERGE`, `APPEND` or `HISTORY_TRACKING`.


<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the Pipeline's id. The selection is read as select = "listed" with the objects
# currently selected.
terraform import hevo_pipeline_objects.postgres 42
```
